title: SetupFormToSlackWebhook
description: The setup modal's submission (see setup_form_to_slack), posted to project-added as a form body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) with a payload field, described decoded: the payload value is JSON text and is described as the JSON value it holds. It is read after the signature check over the raw body. Only a view_submission whose view.callback_id is setup_project is handled; any other interactive payload is answered with an empty 200 and ignored, and is not described here. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

callback_id.description: The callback_id the view was opened with.

private_metadata.description: JSON text {"channel_id": ...} as sent in the modal; project-added parses it and answers 400 if it is not.

values.description: Submitted input values, keyed by block ID (project_url, repo_url) and then by action ID (project_url_input, repo_url_input). A missing input counts as empty.

setup_metadata.description: What private_metadata holds, as project-added sent it.

input_value.description: A plain-text input's state. A missing or null value counts as empty.
